limitations.detail: Exact equivalence is established only for finite deterministic Boolean boundary behavior. Truth-table enumeration scales exponentially with boundary arity.
AND, OR and XOR motifs and held-out rewrites were designed inside the same research program.
The experiment assumes the declared motif boundary contains all behavior relevant to replacement. Latent variables and temporal state are absent.
The result still needs independent implementation or a native test runner reproduction.

nextGates: independent second implementation from frozen preregistration
larger boundary arities with symbolic equivalence rather than full truth tables
automatic motif mining from larger causal graphs
held-out graph families generated independently of the training syntax designer
